comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-profiles-on-open.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1670): Sketch1 (F1) on XY with a 20 x 20 rectangle and Extrude1 (F2), Sketch2 (F3) on XY with a 20 x 20 rectangle beside it and Extrude2 (F4). Both profiles are extruded, so the view shades none outside sketch mode, and the edited sketch's one region is the only profile shown while it is open.
